verdict.rationale: The only deletion-related evidence is that users can request that operators securely shred physical mail from the app or web portal. That is a form of user-controlled destruction of mail items, but it says nothing about digital data retention or deletion. missing for 10: retention settings for scanned mail images, user-initiated deletion of scans and stored data, account/data deletion process, documented retention policy, programmatic/API control over deletion, independent corroboration.
